name: depart
note: 3D75 in the shape the original scripts actually use. All seven original instances are immediately followed by 3D46 (unit withdrawal, code-confirmed) on the same actor — 3D75[166] then 3D46[166,0]; 3D75[3] then 3D46[3,1]; 3D75[999] then 3D46[46,0], where 999 and 46 are both ブライト — and the pair is wrapped in 3D3B 2/3 fades. Earlier isolated probes showed nothing because the command was run alone: this stage runs the pair, and a control that runs 3D46 without 3D75 so the two effects can be told apart. The 3D75 operands are NOT all captains (シュバルツ, ゼクス, アラン fly ordinary mecha); only the seven-entry table at 8021E398 is captains, and non-table actors take one of the four other handlers.

probe A: the removal that always follows it
control: removal WITHOUT the preceding 3D75, so the animation's own contribution is visible
